declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c0 is held at 0.8 and c1 to c4 are held at 0, THE system SHALL end the trial displaced from the start by a small amount, with x between -0.5 and 0.5 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Constant 0.8 on c0, c1 or c2 alone left the body essentially still: x about 2e-5 m, y about 0, heading under 0.005 deg for c0 and c1. c2 gave a 2 deg turn and x of -0.02 m. The prediction x in [-0.5, 0.5] holds, but it only shows that constant drive does not crawl. Time-varying drive (oscillation) is the next thing to test.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN all five channels carry a 1 Hz sine of amplitude 1 with a phase step of 2*pi/5 between neighbouring channels, THE system SHALL end the trial with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Travelling-wave drive moves the body forward

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Travelling-wave drive moves the body forward

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Travelling wave at 1 Hz (T4) gave x = 0.041 m, below the predicted 0.1 m minimum. Heading 0.75 deg, y 0.0002 m, so it went straight but barely moved; x jittered about 0.04 to 0.06 m during the trial. In-phase drive (T5) turned the body to 117 deg with x -0.02 m. Anti-phase (T6) gave x -0.05 m, heading 35 deg. Phase relation between channels affects turning strongly. Frequency should be varied next.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN the five channels carry a travelling-wave sine of amplitude 1, phase step 1.2566 rad and frequency 3 Hz, THE system SHALL end the trial with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Higher frequency travelling wave moves further

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Higher frequency travelling wave moves further

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Travelling wave at 3, 6, 10 Hz gave x = -0.025, 0.021, 0.041 m. All below 0.1 m. Each trial turned steadily (44, 46, 59 deg at the end) with y up to 0.05 m. At 10 Hz the track was smooth: x rose steadily at about 0.008 m/s. Forward speed is far below the 0.06 to 0.1 m/s needed, and the heading drift breaks the 20 deg limit. Full five-channel waves are not enough.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN only c0 and c1 carry a 10 Hz sine of amplitude 1 with c1 lagging c0 by pi/2 and c2 to c4 are zero, THE system SHALL end the trial with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Two channels in quadrature give straighter, faster crawl

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Two channels in quadrature give straighter, faster crawl

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c0 and c1 in quadrature at 10 Hz produced no motion: x 6e-5 m, y -1e-5 m, heading -0.009 deg. c0 and c1 appear inert (also inert with constant drive in E1). Movement in E2 and E3 must come from c2, c3 and/or c4.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN only c2 and c3 carry a 10 Hz sine of amplitude 1 with c3 lagging c2 by pi/2 and the other channels are zero, THE system SHALL end the trial with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c2 and c3 in quadrature at 10 Hz crawl forward

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c2 and c3 in quadrature at 10 Hz crawl forward

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c2 and c3 in quadrature at 10 Hz gave x = 0.008 m, y 0.021 m, heading 17 deg. Far below the 0.1 m predicted. Smooth track, slow creep and slow turn. c2/c3 alone do much less than the full five-channel wave (x 0.041 m at 10 Hz), so c4 or the c2/c3/c4 combination matters.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN only c2, c3 and c4 carry a 10 Hz sine of amplitude 1 with a phase step of 2*pi/3 between neighbours and c0, c1 are zero, THE system SHALL end the trial with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: A three-channel wave on c2 to c4 crawls forward

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: A three-channel wave on c2 to c4 crawls forward

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Three-channel wave on c2, c3, c4 at 10 Hz with 2*pi/3 phase steps gave x = 0.190 m, y = 0.042 m, heading 7.4 deg. x was a smooth steady rise of about 0.04 m/s, so the prediction x above 0.1 m holds. Lateral offset and heading meet the goal limits (0.2 m, 20 deg). x is short of the 0.3 to 0.5 m target. The budget is used up, so this could not be tuned further.
